context: Marketing / Agency / Technology Showcase (Clay Global Inspired, Apple-level restraint, Vercel modernity)
target_audience: Global enterprise clients, tech innovators, founders, design connoisseurs looking for high-craft digital product transformation
emotional_tone: Cinematic, sophisticated, confident, innovative, precise, futuristic yet organic

hierarchy.h1_hero: Oversized 13.45vw desktop / 18vw mobile, 500 weight, -0.075em tracking, masked staggered reveal
hierarchy.h2_section: text-3xl sm:text-4xl lg:text-5xl font-bold tracking-tight leading-tight
hierarchy.overline: text-xs uppercase tracking-[0.25em] text-blue-400 font-mono font-medium

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Original editorial asymmetry, cinematic media, huge typography, no bento or generic service grids; source imagery only
spacing_and_layout.grid_bento: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-8 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-6 lg:gap-8

visual_enhancers.hero_overlay: Art-directed offset film window, desaturated supplied reel, layered typography and selective edge masking
visual_enhancers.magnetic_cursor: Custom glowing dot & ring follower reacting to interactive elements
visual_enhancers.glow_effects: Restrained lime edge highlights on glass icons only; no large ambient neon glows

key_components: Cinematic Hero with background video / R3F dynamic ambient mesh and overlay typography
Floating Glass Navbar with smooth responsive overlay mobile drawer
Interactive Service Matrix with expandable tech specs and micro-interactions
Immersive Project Case-Study Showcase with video preview toggles and metadata badges
Futuristic Tech Core / AI Narrative horizontal scroll feature strip
Client Proof / Editorial Testimonials slider with high contrast quotes
Client-side Interactive Contact Drawer / Form with custom success feedback toast (Sonner)
Custom Cursor & Magnetic CTA Button Wrappers

testing_attributes.rule: Every button, input, link, tab, modal trigger, and major card MUST include data-testid in kebab-case

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a production-ready React component structure using pure Tailwind + Framer Motion for cinematic smoothness.
Do NOT use generic Vercel/Stripe light themes — adhere strictly to the luxury dark tech theme.
Avoid text-align: center globally; keep editorial left alignments with asymmetric accent grids.
Ensure all interactive elements have hover/focus states with data-testid attributes.
Keep client-side state clean for interactive forms, search filters, and case study modals.
